races.title: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Open NH Flat Race (AWT) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: It remains to be seen whether this sharp test will suit point winner GOT TO BE REAL but representing a leading yard, he may well get away with it. Bombus Pascuorum has to carry a penalty for winning an ordinary race last time but he can still be a factor, while this test may be much more suitable for Ezenli given his pedigree. GOT TO BE REAL (IRE) BOMBUS PASCUORUM (IRE) EZENLI (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Got To Be Real (1/4), Bombus Pascuorum (9/2), Allez Jacqueline (9/1), Ezenli (40/1)
